data.name: Aditya Chaturvedi
data.noun: Computer Science Engineer · Data & Cloud Enthusiast
intro: I am a Computer Science and Engineering student at Lovely Professional University with hands-on experience in data analysis, cloud engineering, observability, and full-stack development.

I enjoy turning real-world problems into practical software and data solutions—from multilingual AI-powered public health tools to business-focused sales analysis. I am especially interested in building reliable, accessible products with modern web, cloud, and data technologies.

featured.name: Broadridge Financial Solutions
body: Trained in enterprise DevOps practices spanning CI/CD pipelines, release automation, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.

list: Gained hands-on exposure to Docker, Linux, Jira, and core operating-system and networking fundamentals.
Applied SRE and observability practices including monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis.
Developed an understanding of reliability, scalability, security awareness, and Agile execution in a fintech environment.

data.name: ArogyaBot
data.subtitle: AI-powered public health awareness chatbot
body: A multilingual AI chatbot designed to make reliable public-health information more accessible while identifying health misinformation and urgent situations.

list: Integrated the Google Gemini API for context-aware conversations and natural-language health information processing.
Added misinformation correction, emergency keyword detection, immediate helpline responses, and location-aware healthcare recommendations.
Used Supabase PostgreSQL for anonymous sessions, persistent chat history, health myths, and healthcare resources.
Supports eight Indian regional languages in a responsive application deployed on Vercel.

data.name: Walmart Sales Data Analysis
data.subtitle: Sales data analysis and business insights
body: Analyzed Walmart sales data to identify high-performing branches, products, seasonal trends, and customer purchasing patterns.

list: Performed SQL-based data cleaning, data wrangling, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis.
Produced actionable insights for sales strategy and inventory planning.
Evaluated the factors influencing sales performance across diverse store locations to support stronger business decisions.
